units.source_text: 许多亲王照例都来参与。

en.t: Many princes came to take part, as was customary.

units.source_text: 诸夫人竞工争巧地制作许多佛前供品，都是别出心裁的，各处送来，堆山塞海。

en.t: The ladies vied with one another in skill and ingenuity as they prepared many offerings for the Buddha; each was original in design, and they arrived from every quarter in such abundance that they piled up like mountains and seas.

units.source_text: 布施七僧的法服，凡重要者，皆由紫夫人备办。

en.t: As for the ritual robes to be given in alms to the seven monks, Lady Murasaki prepared all the important ones herself.

units.source_text: 这些法服都用绫绸制成，连袈裟的格子纹都很讲究，懂得此道的人都赞誉为世间少有。

en.t: These robes were all made of figured silk, and even the checked patterns of the monks' kesa were exquisitely considered; those who understood such things praised them as rarely seen in the world.

units.source_text: 这真是过分仔细、太不惮烦了！

en.t: It was truly almost excessively meticulous, and far too painstaking!
